blurb: This control checks the rcnfs boot entry that controls whether the NFS file-sharing service starts automatically when the system boots. A machine that does not need to share files should not be running NFS; if this entry is present, the system boots into a file-sharing service that an attacker can probe and, where its settings are weak, use to reach files on the host. DISA STIG V-215352 states the rule as a prohibition: running "lsitab rcnfs" must yield no output at all, so the check fails whenever any rcnfs record exists in /etc/inittab.
